summary: Prove in Rocq, on the real pair tower, Corollary 2.9 of math/0511691: every Cayley-Dickson algebra is flexible, (x y) x = x (y x), by the paper's self-conjugate trilinear sum and Lemma 2.8, and retain the receipts.

reconciliation.note: Opened from the math-0511691 note, which recorded Corollary 2.9 as established by neither bundle. Scope read from the paper's proof: the sum x(yz) - (xy)z + z(yx) - (zy)x is trivial when an argument is real, is its own conjugate for imaginary arguments, and has real part zero by Lemma 2.8.

scope: proofs/CdAnnihilatorSymmetryReal.v: re_add, re_scale, flex_sum, flex_sum_conj_l, flex_sum_conj_m, flex_sum_conj_r, conj_flex_sum, flex_sum_self_conj, re_flex_sum, flex_sum_zero and flexible at every level of the real tower of proofs/CdTowerReal.v; the bundle docs/evidence/cd-annihilator-symmetry-real/ with two added assumption queries, regenerated receipts and rebound source hashes; the [R] statement in the math-0511691 note, the docs map row and formalization.yaml. Flexibility on the integer tower and the alternative laws (x x) y = x (x y) stay out of scope.

steps.action: Define flex_sum and prove the three one-argument conjugation signs, conj_flex_sum, flex_sum_self_conj, re_flex_sum, flex_sum_zero and flexible in CdAnnihilatorSymmetryReal.v under rocq 9.3.0 with -w @all, each by the alg rewrite database, conj_split and coordinate ring identities.
steps.acceptance: Fails if rocq compile prints any output, if Print Assumptions on flex_sum_zero or flexible lists an axiom other than ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec and FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep, or if a step needs an induction on the level or associativity. Stop condition: a conjugation sign the alg database cannot normalize is recorded with its lemma name and ends the step.

receipts.result: CdAnnihilatorSymmetryReal.v compiles under rocq 9.3.0 on OCaml 5.5.1 with -w @all and no output; Print Assumptions on flex_sum_zero and flexible lists exactly ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec and FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep, as do the fourteen earlier queries, and rocq check passes with an unchanged kernel.txt. Each conjugation sign closes by conj_split, the alg database and a coordinate ring identity; flex_sum_zero uses add_conj and re_associator twice, with no induction on the level and no associativity.

steps.action: Add the two assumption queries to assumptions.v, regenerate assumptions.txt and kernel.txt, rebind source_hashes.sha256, extend the bundle README table and prose, and record the [R] statement in docs/notes/math-0511691.md, docs/README.md and formalization.yaml.
steps.acceptance: Fails if replay_rocq.sh departs from its receipts, if sha256sum -c rejects source_hashes.sha256, if tests/test_evidence_ledgers.py or tests/ci/test_rocq_ci_pins.py fails, if formalization.yaml fails the retained v0.4 schema, or if check_markdown_links.py reports a broken link.

receipts.result: replay_rocq.sh passes against the regenerated receipts (sixteen assumption queries, two axioms each) and sha256sum -c accepts source_hashes.sha256; tests/test_evidence_ledgers.py and tests/ci/test_rocq_ci_pins.py pass (16 tests) under the pinned interpreter; ci/check_rocq_ci_pins.py reports 14 bundles agreeing; formalization.yaml validates against the retained v0.4 schema with jsonschema 4.26.0 and lists flexible among the main results; check_markdown_links.py resolves every link of 704 files.
Both steps are done with receipts at the revision that carries the flexibility theorems, the regenerated receipts and the note statements.

resolution: flex_sum_zero and flexible hold at every level of the real pair tower in proofs/CdAnnihilatorSymmetryReal.v, by the paper's route: the trilinear sum is negated by conjugating any one argument and conjugates to minus the sum of the conjugates, so it is its own conjugate and re_associator cancels its real part; every assumption query lists only the two Stdlib real-construction axioms, the bundle replays against its regenerated receipts, and the math/0511691 note, the docs map and formalization.yaml record the theorem. Flexibility on the integer tower and the alternative laws remain without a Rocq source.
